title: Vector recall healthcheck and drift canary run
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a lightweight evaluation harness and daily canary for embeddings + reranker endpoints that measures recall, ranking fidelity, and early drift signals across slices and scales. Deliverables: (1) a managed nightly job that runs sampled queries against a curated anchor set and synthetic perturbations, (2) a streaming canary for production traffic snapshots to detect distributional shifts, (3) a dashboard and alert thresholds, and (4) integration with rollout logic to gate model variant promotions. This work prioritizes fast signal (low-cost checks) over exhaustive offline gold runs so platform teams can catch regressions before they affect SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly vector recall job executes and completes within budget (< 2k compute units per run)
Recall and nDCG metrics for primary slices are published to Datadog with percent-change deltas vs baseline
Drift detector emits an alert when recall drops > 6% or cosine distribution shifts exceed 1.5 std devs for two consecutive runs
Canary pipeline ingests production snapshot (1% sample) and compares reranker ordering top-10 stability; automated rollback flag available
Runbook created and linked; SRE runbook steps validated in a dry run
milestones: Design doc for anchor + perturbation strategy (completed 2026-02-18)
